definition: A cohesin loader subunit that forms a heterodimeric complex with NIPBL to mediate cohesin loading onto chromatin; heterozygous pathogenic variants in MAU2 cause Cornelia de Lange syndrome 7 (CdLS7), a chromatinopathy displaying variable expressivity ranging from classic CdLS to milder presentations, frequently featuring short stature and microcephaly.

source.title: Pathogenic variants in the cohesin loader subunit MAU2 underlie a distinct Cornelia de Lange Syndrome subtype
source.quote: The role of the cohesin complex depends on the cohesin loader proteins NIPBL and MAU2. While NIPBL variants are a major cause of Cornelia de Lange Syndrome (CdLS), the role of MAU2 in disease is unclear. We describe 18 individuals carrying 15 heterozygous MAU2 variants and demonstrate pathogenicity through functional analyses.
